reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I live out of a tote and forget my pills at home when I travel for work. I'd try one box for the trips, though it's right at my limit at $29.99.
objection: 30 foil packets is a lot of trash, and $30 a month is a stretch on my budget when a regular bottle of magnesium costs less.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price, around $20 to $24 a box, or a smaller trial box so I can test it before committing to 30.
